anomalies.observed: The schematic values and library part name for all of these buffers are SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1, but their BOM/MPN field is U74LVC1G125G-AL5-R. Several of the circuits require a push-pull buffer rather than the open-drain SN74LVC1G07: U27 has A tied to +5V and drives the anode of D2 through R31 to GND; U34 has A tied to +3V3 and sources the LED/power net /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV; U30 drives Q7 gate with no pull-up/pull-down on Net-(Q7-G).
anomalies.expected: The specification states that these are SN74LVC1G07 single non-inverting buffers wired as /OE-controlled sinks. An SN74LVC1G07 open-drain output cannot source current to light D2, cannot power /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV without a pull-up, and cannot reliably drive the Q7 gate without a pull-up. Either the intended part should be a push-pull buffer such as SN74LVC1G125, or the schematic/BOM part identity is inconsistent.
